page.notes: The running head begins with an ornament before "AVSAS" that I read as a Greek or decorative letter; the first word is doubtful. "perrrahat" appears to be a printing error for "pertrahat"; left as printed. "tusfietes" and "ictus" have a doubtful accent mark over the vowel. Line 1 begins mid-word ("chi"), a fragment from the previous line, kept as printed. The Greek fleuron at the very start of the running head is not transcribed.
